description: Source code for tensor element-wise application and mapping functions in PyTorch, including recursive application over tensor dimensions and external function calls.

classes.name: StridedData
classes.description: Helper struct for managing tensor data pointers, strides, and element sizes during recursive application.

methods.name: recursive_apply
methods.description: Recursively applies a Python function to tensor elements across specified dimensions.

methods.name: apply_
methods.description: Applies a Python function element-wise to a CPU tensor, skipping meta tensors.

methods.name: map_
methods.description: Element-wise maps a Python function over a tensor and another tensor, expanding the second tensor if necessary.

methods.name: map2_
methods.description: Element-wise maps a Python function over three tensors, expanding the second and third tensors if necessary.
